messages:
marta (PM): Kicking off rollout plan thread for Atlas feature set. Goal: minimize customer disruption while validating output quality across models and quant profiles. Proposal: dark-launch + phased regional exposure + per-tenant emergency kill-switch. Need alignment on slice sizes, QA gates, and enterprise notice windows.

leo (Eng): Proposal sketch: start with dark (shadow) at 100% traffic in eu-west-1 for 48h to collect quality deltas, then phased real traffic: 0.5% -> 3% -> 15% -> 60% -> 100%. Each step requires KPI pass.

tara (SRE): Agree on dark-launch. Add infra gate: GPU queue latency median < 120ms and GPU utilization < 70% during each ramp step, otherwise halt. Also implement a global kill switch that can force route to stable model.

nina (CS): Customers ask for an "opt-in preview" before GA; enterprise want 72h notice and a dedicated rollback SLA. They also want visibility into output differences (diff report) for their legal teams.

dave (Sales): BigCorp and HealthCo both requested per-region pinning and a no-data-leak clause. They'll only join beta if we provide per-tenant usage caps and a clear cost impact estimate for quantized vs full-precision models.

ci-bot: Canary plan uploaded -> /deploys/atlas_canary -> regions [eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1, us-west-2] -> dark-shadow 48h -> ramps [0.5%,3%,15%,60%,100%] -> automatic hold on KPI fail. Runbook attached.

leo (Eng): Suggested feature-flag JSON (for record):

```json
{
  "flag": "atlas_v1",
  "type": "tenant",
  "stages": [0.005, 0.03, 0.15, 0.6, 1.0],
  "qa_gates": [
    {"metric":"quality_regression","op":">","threshold":0.03,"window":"24h"},
    {"metric":"latency_p99","op":">","threshold":300,"window":"5m"}
  ],
  "fallback":"stable_atlas_v0",
  "audit":true
}
```

leo (Eng): Also propose an A/B shard for quant profiles: cohort A -> fp16, cohort B -> int8+per-channel. Compare cost, latency, and token-level BLEU-like score for prompts. Keep A/B groups small (5% each) during initial ramps.

tara (SRE): Ops notes: add backstop if model-serving queue depth > 250 for 2m OR GPU mem pressure > 90% -> activate fallback. Implement gradual cache drain (60s) to avoid cold-KV thundering. We'll run a chaos job to simulate region network blips during the 3% stage.

nina (CS): I'll prepare customer-facing messaging template: preview invite, audit log sample, and legal checklist. Note: some customers require audit retention 180 days. Can we support configurable retention per-account?

dave (Sales): We should bundle a "beta support" add-on for enterprise customers that includes 24/7 rollback assistance and a dedicated on-call. Pricing TBD.

marta (PM): Decisions needed: (1) dark-launch + shadow 48h before any real traffic (2) staging ramp sizes as above (3) QA gates include both quality_regression and latency_p99 checks (4) per-tenant kill-switch and configurable audit retention (default 90d, enterprise up to 180d) (5) A/B for quant profiles during early ramps.

leo (Eng): Implementation ETA: dark-shadow telemetry + quality delta pipeline -> 2 sprints. Flagging + A/B orchestration -> 1 sprint. Quant experiment infra (cost tracking + automated comparison) -> 1 sprint.

tara (SRE): Infra ETA: queue and mem backstop rules + rollback automation -> 1 sprint. Chaos tests scheduled in staging next Tues.

nina (CS): I'll start customer outreach next week for preview invites. Need marketing copy + legal clearance for per-tenant retention options.

dave (Sales): I'll compile list of pilot candidates and pricing framework. Need eng to confirm expected cost delta between profiles (approx numbers suffice).

marta (PM): Runbook items to add: a) explicit manual pause API for CS with audit trail, b) emergency rollback ladder (dark -> ramp down -> full fallback -> SLA escalation), c) A/B analysis checklist, d) communication timeline for customers.

leo (Eng): One more: add a "quality shadow comparator" that calculates token-level divergence and a simple sentiment/intent-shift metric. If divergence > 7% for any tenant during dark period, mark as human review.

tara (SRE): Also require a manual ops approval after dark period for each region before moving to 0.5% real traffic. This avoids surprises from region-specific infra issues.

marta (PM): Sounds good. Approving the plan contingent on legal OK for 72h enterprise notice and audit-retention options. Target: internal soft-launch in 4 weeks, enterprise previews week after.

ci-bot: Runbook link: http://confluence.internal/atlas-rollout/runbook

leo (Eng): I'll start a PR for the feature-flag schema and the QA pipeline. Tagging tara for infra hooks.

(no further replies)
